verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this subject is a single community comment listing 'forms/webhooks' among Netlify's features (netlify-comm-8). That suggests some outbound webhook capability exists, but no first-party docs describe event subscriptions. The REST API mention (netlify-docs-14) covers programmatic management, not event delivery. Missing for 10: first-party webhook documentation, a list of subscribable event types (e.g. deploy, form, build events), details on payload format and signing, API-based subscription management, and hands-on corroboration.
